these_terms_and_conditions_constitute_th: Obukwakkulizo buno n'ebiragiro byebikola endagaano esookerwako ey'okukozesa app ya Canolia POS. Okwongera okukozesa app eno kiba kitegeeza nti okkirizza ebibikwatako wammanga.
please_read_these_rules_carefully_they_d: Wegayiriddwa soma ebiragiro bino n'obwegendereza. Binnyonnyola eddembe n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwo.
the_user_must_be_at_least_18_years_of_ag: Omukozesa ateekeddwa okuba n'emyaka 18 n'okudda waggulu oba okuba n'olukusa okuva eri omukuumi omutuufu mu mateeka.
information_provided_within_the_app_must: Amawulire agaweebwa mu app gateekeddwa okuba amatuufu.
the_company_reserves_the_right_to_modify: Kkampuni erina eddembe okukyuusa obukwakkulizo buno ekiseera kyonna. Enkyukakyuka zijja kutegeezebwa okuyita mu app.
only_one_account_is_allowed_to_be_opened: Akaawunti emu yokka y'ekkirizibwa okuggulwawo; Tukkirizibwa kuwaayo ddembe lya kukozesa eri balala.
we_hold_your_personal_information_to_the: Tukuuma amawulire go n'omutindo gw'ebyokwerinda ogusinga waggulu. Ffaayo nnyo ku bino wammanga:
do_not_share_your_passwords_and_pins_wit: Togabana password oba PIN yo n'omuntu yenna.
all_payment_information_is_protected_wit: Amawulire gonna ag'okusasula makuume n'enkola ey'okwekuuma y'oku nkomerero (end-to-end encryption).
your_data_will_not_be_sold_to_third_part: Amawulire go tegajja kutundibwa eri abalala okuggyako nga amateeka gabikakatako.
payment_name_hint: Erinnya ly'okusasula (ekyokulabirako MTN MoMo, Airtel Money)
help_app_desc: App ennyangu ey'okuteekateeka ebyafayo by'okusindika n'okuggyayo ssente.
faq_a1: Nyiga akatundu ka '+' akali ku Home screen. Londa 'Transfer' oba 'Withdrawal', wandiika omuwendo n'ebisale, londa engeri y'okusasula, oluvannyuma nyiga 'Save'.
faq_q2: Lwaki naye Transfer n'okuggyayo ssente byawukana?
faq_a2: Transfer kitegeeza nti osindise ssente eri omuntu. Withdrawal kitegeeza nti ggwe oba omuguzi aggyeyo ssente.
faq_q3: Nnyinza ntya okwongerako oba okukyuusa engeri z'okusasula?
faq_a3: Genda mu Settings → Payment Methods. Oyingiza engeri empya, n'okukyuusa eziriwo, oba okubiggyamu.
faq_q4: Nnyinza ntya okukuuma ebyafayo byange ne PIN?
faq_a4: Genda mu Settings → PIN Change. Teeka PIN ey'ennyingo 4–6. App ejja kuba ekusaba PIN buli lwe bagyiggula.
faq_a5: Yee. Ggulawo ebyafayo okuva mu History, nyiga akatundu ak'okusazaamu (Delete). N'osobola okusazaamu ebyafayo byonna singa osazaamu leja.
